leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a brute force solution to find the maximum profit from stock prices
Construct an optimized solution using a single pass through the price array
Initialize and update variables to track minimum price and maximum profit
Manipulate array indices to compare buying and selling days
Apply the algorithm to solve the problem with O(n) time complexity
Integrate the solution into a function that accepts an array of prices
Control loop iterations to prevent selling before buying
lessonTitle: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
